What this mock-up tests

  • Standalone Shieldwall identity; not Vitus's Iron & Ink system.
  • Existing shield-and-axes logo and Njord brand font preserved.
  • Small studio and first product as the real focus; game development mentioned modestly.
  • One-page structure: studio, Vitus, game, roadmap, newsletter, contact.
  • Typography and layout are design proposals; marketing copy is illustrative.
  • Media and forms are demonstrative, not production integrations.

Njord loads from the existing live website when online. The fallback font is used offline.

01 / The studio

A studio built around
the work, not the hype.

We don't need to be the biggest studio in the room. We care about making thoughtful things and making them well.

We're creators first. That shapes the tools we build, the games we make and the way we work.

Shieldwall Games is an independent studio based in Kent, England. What started with games led us to build our own worldbuilding software — and now we're bringing that software to other creators.

We're building in public where we can, improving what we ship, and growing at a pace that lets us stand behind the result.

01 /

Made with purpose

We start with a problem worth solving or a story worth telling.

02 /

Built to last

Ownership, quality and long-term usefulness matter more than unnecessary complexity.

03 /

Independent thinking

Smaller teams can make ambitious things by choosing what matters.

02 / First product

Meet Vitus.

Our first release is a dedicated worldbuilding tool for people who create worlds, stories and adventures.
